newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-SLEEPYTIME GIVES FALLON FIRST CLASSIC SUCCESS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-SLEEPYTIME GIVES FALLON FIRST CLASSIC SUCCESS.

text.p: Sleepytime, a 5-1 chance ridden by Kieren Fallon, swept to a four length success in the English 1,000 Guineas on Sunday.
It was a first classic triumph for Fallon, the new stable jockey to winning trainer Henry Cecil.
Second place went to 50-1 outsider Oh Nellie, the mount of Willie Ryan, with Dazzle (16-1), partnered by John Reid in third.
French raider Pas de Reponse, the 5-2 favourite ridden by Freddie Head, finished fourth of the 15 runners.
